name: Plain
one_liner: API-first customer support platform offering GraphQL and REST APIs alongside native agentic infrastructure and MCP support.
access_note: Plain offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required, followed by per-seat paid plans.

evidence.quote: To call the API as a user in your workspace, use an OAuth app.
7-day free trial, no credit card required.
GraphQL and REST APIs with full UI/API parity and no restrictive rate limits.
You do the setup through Plain’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp, which signs in as that person with OAuth.
